Why is it more comfortable to read text on vertical screens but more comfortable to watch videos and pictures on horizontal screen?

Your eyes are arranged horizontally together. A wide screen is more proportional to your field of vision, and represents a more natural window into a scene. Reading text, anecdotally, works better when you don't require much peripheral vision to keep place. So shorter lines work better, and more lines means less scrolling or mental navigation resets. The vertical orientation fits more lines of text at a more-comfortable length, if the window's maximized.
